description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — To address the aggressive and systematic threats from foreign adversaries, Chairman of the Early Childhood, Elementary, and Secondary Education Subcommittee, U.S. Rep. Aaron Bean (FL-04) introduced H.R. 8649, the Transparency in Reporting of Adversarial Contributions to Education (TRACE) Act.

title: Rep. Aaron Bean: 'Schools are for education, not espionage' - Aaron Bean
